articles.summary: Key features Operating profit increased by 83% to R6.5 billion Headline earnings increased by 89% to R4.3 billion Free cash flow increased by 85% to R2.3 billion Gold production of 4 839kg exceeded annual guidance R3.5 billion invested in capital expenditure Cash and cash equivalents increased by 112% to R2.8 billion, with no debt Final cash dividend of 120 SA cents per share Daggafontein pipeline project commissioned and expanded DP2 plant pours first gold Water Use Licence approved for Libanon reclamation pump station Kloof 2 dump classified as a Mineral Reserve
articles.title: DRDGOLD delivers strong FY2026 results as Vision 2028 takes shape while projects come online

articles.summary: Johannesburg, South Africa. 13 August 2026. DRDGOLD Limited (JSE: DRD, A2X: DRD, NYSE: DRD) expects earnings and headline earnings per share to increase by between 85% and 95% for the year ended 30 June 2026, with production exceeding annual guidance and cash operating costs coming in below guidance.
articles.title: DRDGOLD EXPECTS EARNINGS PER SHARE TO RISE UP TO BETWEEN 85% AND 95% AS PRODUCTION BEATS GUIDANCE
